response.justification: Candidate is a versatile, experienced full-stack/systems engineer with a strong open-source and geospatial (GIS) side project background, but his professional experience is overwhelmingly in JavaScript/TypeScript/Node.js and D, not C++/Rust. His C++ experience is limited to a short 2014-2015 stint and an old university project, with no recent commercial or open-source C++/Rust work, and no evidence of distributed routing-tile pipeline or navigation-guidance experience at production scale.
strengths: Deep geospatial/GIS domain exposure via GISCollective and Green Map projects
Strong generalist engineer with broad systems, embedded, and low-latency (DLang) experience
Demonstrated self-driven learning, teaching, and open-source contribution culture
concerns: Minimal recent C++ experience (last substantial use was 2014-2015) and no listed Rust experience
No direct experience with routing/navigation pipelines, real-time traffic integration, or tile generation at scale
Core professional stack for the past decade is JS/TS/Node, not aligned with C++/Rust-centric role

key_factors.factor: Lack of recent C++/Rust professional experience
